brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: 4 Hex bases placed in line: piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: Vertical water pipe provided in every cell via risers riser:-1,0,0, riser:0,0,0, riser:1,0,0, riser:2,0,0 combined with PVC-bore planter bins bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-pvc, bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-pvc, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-pvc, bin:2,0,0~hex-bin-full-pvc — pipe passes through floor/bore to feed each cell; meshClash clear

finish.summary: Four-cell planter built with plantable PVC-bore bins; every cell contains a vertical riser (water pipe) feeding through the base/bore. Horizontal run alternative was rejected due to pvc-coupling clash with bins; vertical riser solution verified clear.
